gen-tourney-gf-alumni-sans-pinstripe: Stretched, stocky, unmistakably sporty. Tourney cuts every stroke to one width and tracks wide, while Alumni Sans Pinstripe tucks its oversized lowercase into tight, friendly lines beside small capitals.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Vast Shadow draws vintage letters like twine pressed flat, each stroke cut to one width and tall in the mean line. Noto Sans Bamum keeps it modern.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Monoline strokes run from stem to serif in Vast Shadow, giving it a tall, vintage, eye-catching look. Noto Sans Bassa Vah answers with a dominant midsection and an open-jawed c, so the two feel unmistakably different.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Vintage and eye-catching, Vast Shadow bends its letters like tubing. Noto Sans Buhid sits beneath it with a high x-height and generous space between curve ends and stems, so the heading gets all the drama.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-cham: Noto Sans Cham is modern and clean, with tall rounded lowercase. Under Vast Shadow, whose pipe-cleaner letterforms are vintage and eye-catching, it gives the eye a quiet place to rest after each loud heading.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Noto Sans Elymaic reads clean and modern, with open apertures and ascenders that barely clear the x-height. Beneath Vast Shadow's bent-tubing letters, a long stretch of it stays easy going.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Vintage flair meets sturdy lowercase. Vast Shadow holds its thickness steady around every curve and grabs the eye, while Noto Sans Ethiopic does its best work with hanging c terminals and a tall, dependable body.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Vintage, vivid, and utterly without thick-and-thin shifts. Vast Shadow's heading letters sit over Noto Sans Gothic, whose big, drilled-bead counters and parenthesis-like rounds make the text feel open.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-sinhala: Vast Shadow strikes a vintage pose, its t crossbar and stem sharing one width. Noto Sans Sinhala lays down a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line, so a long passage feels dense and steady.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Neutral, yet well lit. Vast Shadow skims along on strokes that never change weight, and Noto Sans Tai Tham crowds its chalkboard lowercase up toward the capital line, a contrast that gives the pair its character.
